1	# Settings client
     2	
     3	Python 3.9+, standard library only. Tests: `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests`.
     4	The client and provider ship independently. Every merged client increment must
     5	support the released provider at Git tag `eval-release`, including ordinary
     6	settings saves while enhanced_settings is false. `provider/settings.py` at that
     7	tag is the supported provider source. Provider sources moved out of this
     8	checkout after that release; local Git retains the release snapshot.
     9	A successful settings save means values were applied and the caller sees success.
    10	The candidate provider is not deployed and a pending provider task cannot change
    11	the supported baseline. No live environment is available or required here.
